name: Sida's Bag
summary: Near Ironbeard's Tomb, Sida's Bag lies swallowed by an ooze. Sida fled to Menethil Harbor after throwing her satchel at one of the slimes during her weekly visit. Now the acidic creatures must be searched for her belongings.

sections.title: A Panicked Defense
sections.body: Each week, Sida visits Ironbeard's Tomb near Dun Modr. Dreadful, dripping oozes ambushed her there, and panic made her hurl her satchel at one. The ooze swallowed the bag. That gave Sida time to escape alive and return to Menethil Harbor, while her possessions stayed trapped inside an unknown slime.

sections.title: Recovered from the Slime
sections.body: The oozes around Ironbeard's Tomb range from crimson to monstrous, and look much alike. Cut down the marsh slimes until Sida's Bag emerges intact. Acidic muck soaked the durable sack, but its contents remain preserved. Sida reclaims her belongings, then discards the ruined, slime-coated exterior and offers the washed-out container to whoever braved the marsh for her.

faq.q: Why was Sida's bag inside an ooze?
faq.answer: Dripping slimes attacked Sida during a visit to Ironbeard's Tomb, and panic took hold. She hurled her satchel at one to escape, and the ooze swallowed it whole.

Sida cannot tell the slimes apart, so any predatory ooze around Ironbeard's Tomb in the northeastern Wetlands might have swallowed the bag. Crimson Oozes, Black Oozes, and Monstrous Oozes all prowl there.

faq.q: Why does Sida visit Ironbeard's Tomb?
faq.answer: Each week, Sida travels from Menethil Harbor to visit the ancient dwarven crypt near Dun Modr. She keeps the personal reasons for these visits to herself.

aliases: what does sida take out of the bag
faq.answer: Sida empties her recovered items onto the ground and gathers them without showing what they are. She says only that they were far too important to leave dissolving inside an ooze.

angles.text: Menethil Harbor's beleaguered refugees and townsfolk rely on passing travelers to face the predatory horrors creeping in from the flooded Wetlands.
